sourceChecks.text: Now the sons of Saul were Jonathan, Ishvi, and Malchishua; and the names of his two daughters were these: the name of the firstborn Merab, and the name of the younger Michal.
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: サウルの二人の娘のうち、年下の娘としてミカルの名を挙げる。

sourceChecks.text: Michal, Saul’s daughter, loved David; and they told Saul, and the thing pleased him.
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: 本文はミカルをサウルの娘として、ダビデを愛したと記す。

sourceChecks.text: David arose and went, he and his men, and killed two hundred men of the Philistines. Then David brought their foreskins, and they gave them in full number to the king, that he might be the king’s son-in-law. Then Saul gave him Michal his daughter as wife.
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: サウルがミカルをダビデの妻として与えたと記す。

sourceChecks.text: Saul saw and knew that the LORD was with David; and Michal, Saul’s daughter, loved him.
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: 本文はミカルをサウルの娘として、ダビデを愛したと記す。

sourceChecks.text: Saul sent messengers to David’s house to watch him and to kill him in the morning. Michal, David’s wife, told him, saying, “If you don’t save your life tonight, tomorrow you will be killed.”
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: ダビデを殺そうとするサウルの使者から、ミカルがダビデを逃がす。

sourceChecks.text: So Michal let David down through the window. He went away, fled, and escaped.
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: ダビデを殺そうとするサウルの使者から、ミカルがダビデを逃がす。

sourceChecks.text: Michal took the teraphim and laid it in the bed, and put a pillow of goats’ hair at its head and covered it with clothes.
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: ダビデを殺そうとするサウルの使者から、ミカルがダビデを逃がす。

sourceChecks.text: Saul said to Michal, “Why have you deceived me like this and let my enemy go, so that he has escaped?” Michal answered Saul, “He said to me, ‘Let me go! Why should I kill you?’”
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: ダビデを殺そうとするサウルの使者から、ミカルがダビデを逃がす。

sourceChecks.text: Now Saul had given Michal his daughter, David’s wife, to Palti the son of Laish, who was of Gallim.
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: 本文がミカルをサウルの娘、ダビデの妻として名指す。
